# PyramidChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPyramidChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasPyramidChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasPyramidChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasPyramidChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A static hierarchy whose levels are parts of a whole

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasPyramidChart](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasPyramidChart.md)

- [UltraCanvasChartEngineProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasChartEngineProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPyramidChart> CreatePyramidChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPyramidChart> CreatePyramidChartWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, std::shared_ptr<PyramidDataSource> data, const std::string& title = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPyramidChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onLevelClick` | `std::function<void(size_t levelIndex)> onLevelClick` | Indices are into the data source, so sorting never shifts them |
| `onLevelHover` | `std::function<void(size_t levelIndex)> onLevelHover` | _Level hover_ |
| `onCalloutClick` | `std::function<void(size_t levelIndex)> onCalloutClick` | _Callout click_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `PyramidSubSegment`

One slice of a level, used to break it down by segment, region, product or whatever else divides the population sitting at that tier.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `std::string label` |  |
| `value` | `double value` |  |
| `color` | `Color color` | Transparent = shade the level colour by position |

### struct `PyramidLevel`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `levelLabel` | `std::string levelLabel` | "Self-actualisation", "Unit tests", ... |
| `levelValue` | `double levelValue` | Size of this tier - optional, see SetValuesEnabled() |
| `calloutTitle` | `std::string calloutTitle` | Heading of the side callout; empty falls back to levelLabel |
| `description` | `std::string description` | Body of the side callout |
| `badgeText` | `std::string badgeText` | Short marker, e.g. "01"; empty falls back to the position |
| `iconPath` | `std::string iconPath` | Drawn in the icon callout style and inside the band |
| `levelColor` | `Color levelColor` | Transparent = take the colour from the colour mode |
| `targetValue` | `double targetValue` | &lt;= 0 disables the target overlay for this level |
| `tooltipText` | `std::string tooltipText` | Optional custom tooltip replacing the generated one. Tooltips are rendered as Pango markup: the generated text escapes &, &lt; and &gt; for you, but text supplied here is passed through verbatim so it can carry markup. |
| `segments` | `std::vector<PyramidSubSegment> segments` | Empty = solid level |

Methods: `HasSegments`, `GetSegmentTotal`

### struct `PyramidLevelMetrics`

Everything the chart derives about one level from the rest of the pyramid. Computed on demand rather than stored, so editing a value can never leave it stale. A pyramid is a hierarchy, not a process, so none of these are conversions: they describe a part against the whole and against the tier underneath it.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `double value = 0.0` |  |
| `percentOfTotal` | `double percentOfTotal = 0.0` | Share of every level added together |
| `percentOfBase` | `double percentOfBase = 100.0` | Share of the widest tier at the bottom |
| `ratioToLevelBelow` | `double ratioToLevelBelow = 100.0` | Size against the tier directly beneath |
| `cumulativeFromBase` | `double cumulativeFromBase = 100.0` | Share of the total held by this level and everything below it |
| `cumulativeFromApex` | `double cumulativeFromApex = 0.0` | ... and by this level and everything above it |
| `levelFromBase` | `size_t levelFromBase = 0` | 0 = the base |
| `levelFromApex` | `size_t levelFromApex = 0` | 0 = the apex |

### enum `PyramidInputOrder`

X11 pollutes the global namespace with None, Above, Below, Always and friends, so every enumerator below carries a descriptive suffix. Which end of the supplied vector is the apex. The chart always draws apex to base internally, so this only says how to read the data.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ApexFirst` | levels\[0\] is the narrow tier at the top |
| `BaseFirst` | levels\[0\] is the widest tier at the bottom |

### enum `PyramidShapeMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SegmentedPyramid` | Trapezoid tiers separated by a gap - the default |
| `SolidPyramid` | One triangle cut by level lines, tiers touching |
| `SteppedPyramid` | Rounded slabs stacked into a ziggurat |
| `Pyramid3D` | Extruded solid with a lit top face and a shaded side |
| `CardRows` | Rounded row card per tier with the wedge running through it |
| `SkewedInfographic` | Sheared presentation slabs, alternating direction |
| `ExplodedPyramid` | Tiers offset sideways, each one pulled out of the stack |
| `BarStylePyramid` | Plain centred bars - the accessible variant |

### enum `PyramidDirection`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ApexUp` | Classic pyramid |
| `ApexDown` | Inverted pyramid |
| `ApexLeft` | Horizontal, narrow end on the left |
| `ApexRight` | Horizontal, narrow end on the right |

### enum `PyramidScaleMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `EqualLevels` | Every tier the same height - the hierarchy diagram, the default |
| `HeightProportional` | Tier height tracks the value |
| `WidthProportional` | Tier width tracks the value, heights stay equal |
| `AreaProportional` | Drawn trapezoid area tracks the value - the honest pyramid |
| `VolumeProportional` | Solid-of-revolution volume tracks the value, for Pyramid3D |

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|

### struct `PyramidLevelGeometry`

One entry per drawn level, rebuilt with the rendering cache. Rendering, hit testing, callout placement and label placement all read from here so they can never disagree.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `dataIndex` | `size_t dataIndex = 0` | Index into the data source, unaffected by sorting |
| `polygon` | `std::vector<Point2Dd> polygon` | Front face outline in element coordinates |
| `bandStart` | `double bandStart = 0.0` | Along the flow axis, measured from the apex |
| `bandEnd` | `double bandEnd = 0.0` |  |
| `halfExtentStart` | `double halfExtentStart = 0.0` | Across the flow axis, at bandStart (nearer the apex) |
| `halfExtentEnd` | `double halfExtentEnd = 0.0` | ... and at bandEnd |
| `crossOffset` | `double crossOffset = 0.0` | Sideways displacement in ExplodedPyramid mode |
| `center` | `Point2Dd center` | Where inside labels land |
| `color` | `Color color` |  |
| `metrics` | `PyramidLevelMetrics metrics` |  |
| `topFace` | `std::vector<Point2Dd> topFace` | Extruded faces - empty outside Pyramid3D |
| `sideFace` | `std::vector<Point2Dd> sideFace` |  |
| `calloutRect` | `Rect2Dd calloutRect` | Callout block resolved by the layout pass. width/height of 0 means the level has nothing to say and no block was reserved. |
| `calloutAnchor` | `Point2Dd calloutAnchor` | Point on the tier edge the connector leaves from |
| `calloutAtStartSide` | `bool calloutAtStartSide = false` |  |
